SourceString: Your {P_C}profession{##} defines the actions you can take, others' {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of you, and how you progress through {P_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grades{##}.
You may unlock and specialize in multiple {P_C}professions{##} without losing progress or benefits, but only one can be {A_ACTPRO_C}set as your line of work{##} at a time.
{CHAR_XP_C}Experience{##} is earned exclusively in your Active Profession and used to advance its {P_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grades{##}.
Operates an {B_OCC_ALC_C}Alchemist's Lab{##}, researching mixtures, remedies, and {A_ACT_PESCON_C}pest-control{##} concoctions.
A profession defines your trade and determines which {B_TYP_OCCBUI_C}business building{##} you can operate.
Over time, you gain {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##} in your {P_ACTPRO_C}active profession{##}, advancing through six {A_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grades{##} within its {B_GUILD_C}guild{##}.
Higher grades unlock building upgrades, new actions, and passive benefits.
Manages burial grounds and oversees operations at the {B_OCC_GRA_C}Graveyard{##}.
Oversees security operations and commands the {B_OCC_GUA_C}Barracks{##}, organizing {A_ACT_GUAPAT_C}patrols{##} and maintaining order.
Owns and manages an {B_OCC_INN_C}Inn{##}, hosting travelers while {A_ACT_FINEVIFROWOR_C}gathering rumors{##} and arranging {A_ACT_LIVPER_C}entertainment{##}.
Oversees a {B_OCC_JOI_C}Joiner's Workshop{##}, supplying wooden tools, and {A_ACT_IMPCAR_C}sturdier carts{##}.
Controls loans, debts, and financial dealings from a {B_OCC_MONLEN_C}Counting House{##}.
Runs a {B_OCC_PER_C}Perfumery{##}, producing fragrances and scented goods that {A_ACT_SCEENH_C}attract customers{##}.
Leads worship and oversees affairs within a {B_OCC_PRE_C}Church{##}, delivering {A_ACT_HOLSTRSER_C}sermons{##}, {A_ACT_PASVIS_C}absolving sins{##}, and {A_PRAOTH_C}praying{##} for the faithful.
Commands raids and controls a {B_OCC_ROB_C}Robber Baron's Fortress{##}, organizing {A_ACT_ROB_C}break-ins{##} and {A_ACT_WAYTRA_C}cart ambushes{##}.

Owns and operates a {B_OCC_SMI_C}Smithy{##}, producing metal goods, tools, and weapons. They install iron bars on windows to {A_ACT_STRBAR_C}reinforce security{##}, giving would-be robbers serious second thoughts.
Directs stoneworking projects and operates a {B_OCC_MAS_C}Masonry{##}, {A_ACT_IMPQUA_C}improving roads{##} and {A_ACT_IMPSTR_C}building foundations{##}.
Operates a {B_OCC_TAI_C}Tailor's Workshop{##}, producing garments and {A_ACT_SEWCLO_C}refining attire{##} for paying clients.
Leads covert operations from a hidden {B_OCC_THI_C}Hideout{##}, orchestrating {A_ACT_PICPOCCIT_C}scams{##}, {A_ACT_PICPOC_C}thefts{##}, and {A_ACT_FRAFORCRI_C}planted evidence{##}.
Manages trade operations and oversees goods stored in a {B_OCC_TRA_C}Storehouse{##}.
Leads performances and manages a {B_OCC_ENT_C}Travelling Circus Camp{##}, drawing crowds with spectacles and amusement.
What calling shall you first embrace?  You may learn more professions later.
Here are the professions available for your chosen backstory.
You steadily gain experience in your {P_ACTPRO_C}active profession{##} as time passes.
If you want to accelerate that growth, consider enrolling in {A_TRAPRO_C}specialized training{##} at the {B_GUILD_C}Guild{##} to earn a {A_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grade{##} more quickly.
Your {CHAR_CITVSWOR_C}workers{##} also accumulate experience over time, but they'll be ready for a {A_PROWOR_C}promotion{##} much sooner if you {A_TRAWOREXP_C}mentor{##} them.
Once the progress bar is full, go to the {B_GUILD_C}Guild{##} and advance to the next {P_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grade{##} in your profession.
Once the progress bar is full, the character can advance to a higher {P_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grade{##} in their field of work.
